description: This file defines the MeetingMigrationService class responsible for migrating legacy calendar meeting sync data to a new system. It includes methods for validation, data retrieval, and migration processes, focusing on Google Calendar integration and legacy data cleanup.

classes.name: MeetingMigrationService
classes.description: Handles migration of meeting sync data from legacy fields to the new calendar system, ensuring data integrity and cleanup.

methods.name: validateMeetingMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Checks existence of necessary database tables for migration.

methods.name: migrateMeetingSyncData
methods.description: Performs the migration of meeting data, optionally as a dry run.

methods.name: findMeetingsWithGoogleSync
methods.description: Retrieves meetings with legacy Google sync data for a specific user.

methods.name: findCalendarAccountForUser
methods.description: Finds the calendar account ID associated with a user, based on user ID.

methods.name: hasExistingCalendarAccountMeeting
methods.description: Checks if a calendar account meeting record already exists for given meeting and account IDs.

methods.name: createCalendarAccountMeeting
methods.description: Creates a new calendar_account_meetings record from legacy sync data.

methods.name: cleanupLegacyMeetingSync
methods.description: Removes legacy sync fields (gsync_id, gsync_lastsync) from the meetings table post-migration.
